scope: GeoJSON/KML farm-zone imports and spatial-import audit failure reporting

behavior.feature_failures: Per-feature and per-Placemark results and durable audit errors contain only operation and exception class; raw source/coordinate/database text is omitted.
behavior.invalid_kml: Malformed XML returns a bounded parser-class summary without echoing source payload.
behavior.audit_write_failure: Failure to persist an import audit logs only the exception class.
behavior.partial_import: Existing feature counters, partial/failed status selection, and best-effort audit behavior remain unchanged.

coverage: GeoJSON feature exceptions are redacted from response, audit payload, and logs
KML Placemark exceptions are redacted from response, audit payload, and logs
invalid KML payload is not echoed in the result
spatial audit-write exceptions are reduced to their class in logs

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake cursors and synthetic spatial payloads

limitations: No PostGIS database or live spatial file was used.
This does not verify imported geometries against a populated farm-zone fixture.
